subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors.
stimulus: A miser got some money (a) ----- he was not pleased with it. He was in constant fear (b) ----- thieves would steal it. (c) ----- he thought it is necessary to devise some steps (d) ----- no one might get scent of it and steal it. (e) ----- much thought he bought a lump of gold with all his money and buried it at a secret place.
guide_solution: Use of sentence connectors (a) but; (b) that; (c) So; (d) so that/in order that; (e) After.
